Control NK-VUL-01 (technical vulnerabilities are tracked and fixed within set times): NOT EVIDENCED in the policy library. Ten searches covered security advisories, vulnerability management, patch management, critical-vulnerability remediation timelines, the 14-day fix window, and exception approval/recording. None returned a policy addressing vulnerability handling.

- VUL-1 (advisory sources monitored): no policy found.
- VUL-2 (critical weaknesses fixed within 14 days): no policy found. The only remediation-timing text retrieved (encryption-policy, "Monthly check") covers laptop encryption status, not vulnerabilities, and the 14-day figure does not appear in any retrieved document.
- VUL-3 (exceptions approved and recorded): no policy found. The backup-policy restore-test record and the general policy-owner listings are unrelated.

The retrieved documents (acceptable-use, access-control, backup, encryption) were checked and do not govern vulnerability handling, so I have not cited them as support. Recommended next step: ask the control owner for the vulnerability management or patch management standard, and confirm whether one exists. Until it is produced, the control cannot be rated as effective.
